tools.name: fieldclimate_get_user
tools.description: The FieldClimate account of the API key: username, company, address and settings. GET /user.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_sensor_catalog
tools.description: The FieldClimate sensor catalogue: sensor codes, names and units, for reading station sensor data. GET /system/sensors.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_crops
tools.description: The crops known to FieldClimate, for crop zones. GET /system/crops.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_stations
tools.description: All weather stations and devices linked to the account, with names, positions and rights. GET /user/stations.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_station
tools.description: One station: name, position, rights, configuration and dates. GET /station/{stationId}.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_station_sensors
tools.description: The sensors of one station, with names, units and calibration. GET /station/{stationId}/sensors.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_station_data_range
tools.description: The first and last dates with data for one station. Use it before a data read to see if new data arrived. GET /data/{stationId}.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_last_station_data
tools.description: Station measurements for the last period (for example 24h or 7d) in one data group. GET /data/{stationId}/{dataGroup}/last/{timePeriod}.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_station_data_period
tools.description: Station measurements between two unix timestamps (seconds) in one data group. The vendor tier limits the history. GET /data/{stationId}/{dataGroup}/from/{from}/to/{to}.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_farms
tools.description: All farms of the account. GET /farms.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_farm
tools.description: One farm of the account. GET /farms/{farmID}.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_farm_fields
tools.description: The fields of one farm. GET /farms/{farmID}/fields.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_fields
tools.description: All fields of the account, across farms. GET /fields.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_field
tools.description: One field: name, farm and boundary data. GET /fields/{fieldID}.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_crop_zones
tools.description: All crop zones of the account: crops, sowing and harvest dates, and soil data. GET /crop-zones.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_crop_zone
tools.description: One crop zone: crop, dates, boundary, soil and irrigation events. GET /crop-zones/{cropzoneID}.
